result.Method of Attack: Malicious PDF downloader leading to ZIP file with MSI installer; DLL sideloading via Lightshot.exe to execute malicious Lightshot.dll; keylogging, screen blocking, deceptive pop-ups, credential theft from banking and cryptocurrency portals
result.Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious PDF containing downloader link; ZIP file download and MSI installer execution; DLL sideloading
